gaps.explanation: The results receive the action: 'will be announced'.

gaps.sentence: The passengers ___ to fasten their seatbelts as the plane entered the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'The passengers were told to …' — passive of 'tell somebody to do'.

gaps.sentence: Overnight the empty field ___ (TRANSFORM) into a car park.
gaps.explanation: A single completed change in the past: was transformed.

gaps.sentence: The two leaders ___ (report) to have reached a provisional agreement.
gaps.explanation: Plural subject needs are: are reported to have reached (perfect infinitive for the earlier event).

gaps.sentence: Hamlet ___ (perform) almost continuously since it was written.
gaps.explanation: 'Since + past clause' requires present perfect passive: has been + performed.

gaps.sentence: He refuses ___ (tell) what to do by people he's never met.
gaps.explanation: 'Refuse' takes a to-infinitive; passive meaning needs to be + told.

gaps.sentence: The theatre ___ in 1897 and reopened last year.
gaps.explanation: A finished date (1897) takes past simple passive: was + built.

gaps.sentence: The national anthem ___ (compose) by a little-known music teacher.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + composed; 'by a music teacher' names the agent.
